blurb: Eagle Valley Golf Course offers 18 and 9 hole golf rounds with options for walking or riding. They provide memberships with benefits including discounted green fees, advance reservations, and golf shop discounts. The facility includes a banquet and meeting room available for rent and a large practice area with a driving range and practice green.
extraNote: 100% green fee guarantee excluding twilight rates; credit issued if unable to complete holes due to rain or time · No-show fee of $25 per player for unused reservations · Reservations accepted up to 5 days in advance for general public, 7 days for members · Carts reserved for golfers only; no ride-along privileges · Reservation cancellations due to weather result in forfeited reservation · Deposit of $250 required for full banquet facility rentals
